paragraphs: Neptune Technology Group sells a metering system for water utilities. The products page covers software, data collectors, endpoints, registers and water meters, and says the parts are designed and engineered to work together. The water meters page groups meters as residential, commercial and industrial, and fire service.

The software is described as built for water utilities by water experts, with data available anytime and from anywhere. That software is offered as a way to use AMR/AMI data. Neptune describes working with a utility to build an adaptable AMI system with full compatibility. The registers are described as giving utilities options from monthly meter reading to customer consumption data and alarms for continuous leaks and reverse flow events.
The water meters page says Neptune has helped thousands of utility customers across North America. Neptune states that its solutions are adaptable to a utility's operations, team and community.

quote.text: Because water meters are a utility's cash registers, the solution begins with measurement integrity at each water meter.
